attributes.action: As the PM has now resigned the people should have an election for who is next PM
attributes.additional_details: It is only right that we the people decide on who leads our country after years of change when the tories where in power we do not want this again and i believe an election should be allowed for the right to reside in number 10 and should it be Mr Burnham the people want then it has been done correctly. There has been to many lies and cohersion by this government its already time for a clean slate
attributes.background: As the people voted Kier Stamer into power and he has now resigned it is only right that the people are allowed to vote in the next PM/party and it should not be left to parliment to choose the next PM especially after the multipul change of leadership when the tories where in power.
